document:4:160:0.text:
<style="highlight">Radishes</style> and <style="highlight">spiritroots</style> are gifts of nature. They can boost your strength and protect against the cold. First, peel and finely chop the radishes, then simmer them on low heat to remove any bitterness.

Add the spiritroots to the pot and let it stew on high heat. Their faint fragrance balances out the sweetness of the radishes. Once their combined flavors are fully released, you'll have a delicious, nourishing soup.

Something perfect for warming both your hands and your body on a chilly day!
document:4:160:0.source_cn:
<style="highlight">葱萝</style>与<style="highlight">灵曼根</style>是自然的恩赐，具有增强体质、抵御寒气的功效，先将葱萝去皮切碎后低温慢煮，去除异味。

将灵曼根直接切入锅中高温炖煮，搭配上灵曼根的淡雅香气可以中和葱萝的甜度，充分释放大地的鲜香与灵气后，美味滋补汤即可出锅。

冬日里来上一碗，暖手又暖身！
